item.title: YouTuber 'Ben Palmer' Sets Up Fake ICE Tip Line, Catches Kindergarten Teacher Reporting Her Student's Parents
item.description: Kindergarten Teacher Calls ICE On Student refers to backlash over a viral video by YouTuber Ben Palmer where he shares a recording of a kindergarten teacher calling into his fake ICE tip line to report one of her students and their parents, who she suspects might be undocumented. The video was uploaded on February 2nd, 2026 and went viral over the following days, inspiring reactions from some people on social media, including attempts to find the teacher and get her fired.

item.title: 'I Prefer My Ice Crushed' Comment Deemed Insensitive By Many, Becomes A Huge Meme Across Social Media
item.description: I Prefer My Ice… Crushed is a viral comment purportedly left on a TikTok video of an ICE agent assaulting somebody in Minneapolis, accompanied by an edited photo of a cat wearing makeup and looking down on a subject.
